timeline.tweet: I don't remember who most of them were, I just remember being angry they replaced the original members. The one that did stand out to me however...
I am shaking and crying right now. Not gonna lie I FUCKING DID IT. I thought #TheCorrupted was way harder until the final stretch of #ChasmOfScreams which is maddening due to the #Thralls.

Went for a nap at 8. Just woke up. Guess I didn't realise how tired I was. Feel good this morning, but also feel like I could easily sleep more too.
I’m not much of a drinker or much of a social person, but I do miss the option of being able to go out and do stuff. I literally can’t remember the last time I left my house.

Relentlessly bullied at school, causing life long mental damage, self esteem and trust issues. Mum also died when I was 17, when I was already in a very fragile place mentally, causing my life to completely spiral. I was diagnosed with depression and spent years in counselling.

Gotten into a real bad habit lately of staying up late on Saturdays, sleeping in on Sundays and then coming to go to bed for work on the Monday and just being wide awake. 12 hours after I get up is usually when I have my dinner, not usually when I’m trying to go to sleep.

I feel like "it could be worse" is such a passive aggressive, dismissive, reductive, statement. You can't feel shitty or feel shitty about something because someone, somewhere, is having a worse time? Get that shit into the sea. Everyone is entitled to a bad day.
Fucking terrifying. Everything is fucking terrifying.
Fucking terrifying. Everything is fucking terrifying.
It is like those people who say "just don't be sad".

While it did make some of my days off very short, the highlight of my week off was being free of the alarm clock prison. I can’t even begin to explain how much better I started to feel once I started sleeping when my body wanted to sleep and waking up when my body was ready.

My lack of focus goes the other way and I end up playing like 10 hrs of 6 different games and not finish anything, when I know I could’ve used that time to finish at least one of them. I’m picky with games though, I usually only really play one game a year that really grabs me.
